rule: Room capacity must be >= participants
All required room features must be present
Activity must fit within room availability and closure windows including setup/teardown
No overlapping activity occupancy intervals in a room
Every required service must be available for the entire activity; degraded service is not enough unless approved activity mode explicitly tolerates it
Start must be within earliest_start and latest_start and within max advance/delay relative to original start
Scheduled duration must be between minimum_duration_minutes and duration_minutes; critical exams/events require full duration unless activity row says otherwise
Hard dependencies require source end + minimum gap <= target start
Soft dependencies add a penalty when source completion/continuity conditions are not met; they do not automatically block scheduling
Required role count must be covered by qualified staff available for full activity; no staff overlap and breaks must be respected
Rooms requiring facilitator must have the required facility-qualified staff role assigned
Engineer must have required or declared secondary skill, be available for whole nonpreemptible job and verification, and work one job at a time
Prerequisite jobs must finish including verification before dependent jobs start
A required part must be in stock at job start; inventory is consumed once per job
Only completed mapped work requests change service state; downstream service links remain blocked until dependencies are healthy
Minimize cancellations first, then priority-weighted delay, then relocations, then soft dependency violations, then engineering completion time
Laboratory activities require lab_technician and controlled_access; food-service activities require food_service_lead and approved food venue
Missing service/availability/qualification data is unknown and cannot be treated as available
Cancellation or deferral is permitted only where activity flags allow it; cancellations incur the declared penalty
Prefer original room and original start when all higher-priority objectives are equal
